info.name: RideLink - Final E2E
info.description:
Final integrated RideLink E2E collection for Account, Driver & Vehicle, Ride Management, and Fare & Payment services. Run services with the same JWT_SECRET and INTERNAL_API_KEY values before executing. Ride creation itself triggers Ride -> Fare estimate and Ride -> Driver lookup/reservation; this collection does not manually call internal fare estimate during ride creation. Optional manual negative demo: stop or misconfigure Fare Service, then run Passenger Create Ride to observe Ride Service returning 503.

Demo precondition: Before running the full E2E demo, ensure the selected service area has exactly one eligible AVAILABLE driver: the fresh driver created by this collection. If older demo drivers are still AVAILABLE in the same service area, Ride Service may correctly assign one of them instead. Use the non-mutating precondition request in Driver Setup to verify this state. If it fails, mark old demo drivers UNAVAILABLE through existing Driver APIs before rerunning; do not delete data.

exec: pm.test('Driver profile account matches driver account', () => pm.expect(String(body.accountId)).to.eql(pm.environment.get('driverAccountId')));
